- **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/src/kernel/index.ts`, `packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts`, `packages/spec/src/system/settings-manifest.zod.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **170** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json af8aab1b1c4f479b9b102da9227279534b4d27cd` → `packageMentionDocs`.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f1e4de5bd241aa4f7569580a535089706ce97443`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/kernel/index.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts, packages/spec/src/system/settings-manifest.zod.ts + packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/index.ts, packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/{mail,branding,localization}.manifest.ts, packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service.types.ts (`envKeyOf`), packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service.ts (`effectiveEnvOverride`), packages/spec/scripts/build-docs.ts, content/docs/references/system/settings-manifest.mdx, docs/adr/0007-settings-manifest-and-kv-store.md, .changeset/30282-feature-flags-namespace-text.md, ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/console-copy-system-noun-12956.test.ts (read for ③ only), PR #30595's `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/{zh-Hans,zh-Hant,pt-BR}.ts` and `zh-hant-generated.test.ts` at `9b15e9ad` (read for ③ only)

Independent reviewer, read-only: the net diff `aad1603c..f1e4de5b` (16 files, +96/−20), card #30282 with 6650008971 / 6650110716 / 6666332896 / 6668613789, and the head's check-runs. Timestamp 2026-11-05T20:44Z.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set: unchanged — right.** The three spec hunks are comment text only: two `//` lines in the `kernel/index.ts` barrel, the module docblock of `public-auth-features.ts`, and line 14 of the module docblock of `settings-manifest.zod.ts`. No `z.*` call, no `.describe()`, no export, no type is touched (`settings-manifest.zod.ts` L74–L694 `.describe()` strings are all untouched; `SettingsManifestSchema` at L680 unchanged). The diff carries no change to `packages/spec/api-surface/**`, `declaration-map/**`, `json-schema.manifest`, `liveness/**` or `docs/**`, and `check:generated` reports all 14 generated artifacts current on this head (the dev's run, confirmed by the green `Lint · docs & code guards` / `Build Docs` check-runs). A `git grep feature_flags` of `origin/main` outside tests, CHANGELOGs, `skills/**` and release notes finds the three source sites, the mdx, two ADRs, one audit and one cache-doc example — no JSON Schema or API-surface artifact carries the string, so nothing else was owed regeneration.
- **Published surfaces reached — named right.** (a) `settings-manifest.zod.ts` L14 is NOT a `.describe()`; it is the module docblock, which `packages/spec/scripts/build-docs.ts` L511–L536 projects through `modulePageDescription(...)` into the mdx frontmatter `description` and the page's opening paragraph. The regenerated `content/docs/references/system/settings-manifest.mdx` L4 and L12 follow it exactly — this is the one generated artifact the change reaches, and it is in the diff. It is not projected into JSON Schema (that reads `.describe()` only). (b) The `public-auth-features.ts` docblock and the `settings-manifest.zod.ts` docblock are JSDoc-style leading comments of the next declaration (`PublicAuthFeatureSurface`, `SpecifierType`), so TypeScript's declaration emit (JSDoc-only comment retention) carries them into `dist/kernel/index.d.ts` / `dist/system/index.d.ts` under the tsup `BUILD_DTS` pass (`packages/spec/tsup.config.ts` L475–L487); no `dist/` exists in the shared checkout and no published tarball is in `node_modules`, so this is read from the emitter's rule, not from an artifact. (c) The `kernel/index.ts` `//` note never ships: non-JSDoc comments are dropped from `.d.ts`. Net: one change reaches the docs site, up to two reach the published `.d.ts` text, none reaches a schema, a type, or the API surface.
- **The PR body's account ("comments only, no schema/type/export change") matches the tree.**

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/30282-feature-flags-namespace-text.md`: `'@objectstack/spec': patch`, `'@object-ui/i18n': patch`, body carries `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` as line-initial declarations, and the PR body carries the same two lines. Against AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3: both packages are released (`@object-ui/i18n` is `18.3.0`, not `private`; `@objectstack/spec` publishes `dist/**/*.d.ts` and the docs page), the diff publishes from each (a shipped UI string in ten packs; docblock text in the spec `.d.ts` and reference page), so `skip-changeset` would be wrong and `patch` is the level a `none` kind takes. No authorable key, export or value is added, removed or re-meant, so `Metadata-protocol: none` and `Clause-②: no` (no arm) are right. `Check Changeset` is green on the head. **Level and declarations: right.**

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Addendum 6650008971 (settings-manifest.zod.ts L14 + mdx L4/L12):** done — the example is replaced, not dropped, and the mdx is regenerated in the same PR (the addendum offered "drop the example"; replacing it with a registered namespace is at least as good, see ④).
- **Triage 6650110716:** p3, `domain:spec`, ui half named — both halves are in this PR under the one `domain:spec#2` claim 6666332896, whose file surface this diff stays inside (three spec files, the mdx, the subtitle in every pack, one test, one changeset; nothing under `skills/**`, `docs/adr/**`, `content/docs/releases/**`, `.claude/**`, `AGENTS.md`).
- **Dev report 6668613789, `open_questions`: []** — nothing to answer there.
- **Serial note — PR #30595 still open (draft, head `9b15e9ad`, 144 files):** judged on its actual patches. It renames `zh.ts → zh-Hans.ts` (+5/−1, header lines only) and `pt.ts → pt-BR.ts` (+0/−0, pure rename), adds a generated `zh-Hant.ts` (5,164 lines) and `zh-hant-generated.test.ts` (byte-for-byte equality with `gen-zh-hant.mjs` over `zh-Hans.ts`), and changes line 54 only of `console-copy-system-noun-12956.test.ts` (`builtInLocales.zh` → `builtInLocales['zh-Hans']`). This PR edits line ~1921 of `zh.ts` / ~1882 of `pt.ts` and appends after line 69 of the same test. **Either landing order merges cleanly:** the renames are ≥99 % similar, so git's rename detection carries this PR's one-line hunks onto `zh-Hans.ts` / `pt-BR.ts`, and the two test-file hunks do not overlap. The new describe is key-agnostic (`Object.entries(builtInLocales)`, floor ≥ 10), so it holds on eleven packs under the new keys. **One consequence the dev's note does not name:** `zh-Hant.ts` on #30595's head reads `subtitle: '配置系統、整合與功能開關。'` (OpenCC `s2twp` output), so whichever PR lands second ships a Traditional pack still promising feature flags until `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n gen:zh-hant` is re-run; #30595's own byte-for-byte test reds that state, so the regeneration is forced, but by #30595's guard, not this PR's. This PR's pin matches `/功能开关/u` (Simplified) and so does NOT catch the generator's `功能開關` — the PR body's "a `zh-Hant` pack that copies the old Chinese wording is caught" holds for a verbatim Simplified copy only. **should-fix (lane seat's file, outside `hits`, not a FAIL):** add `/功能開關/u` to `FEATURE_FLAG_TERMS` in `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/console-copy-system-noun-12956.test.ts` L86–L96 so the pin holds the Traditional pack on its own merits.
- **Dev's local exit 1 on `ui/scripts/__tests__/date-only-zone-pins-10183.test.ts`:** that file is in the ui `unit` vitest project (`ui/vitest.config.mts` L409 `scripts/**/*.test.ts`), so the `Test UI (n/16)` shards on this head are its verdict, not the dev's control-worktree account. At this record's stamp the head's check-runs stood at 27 success, 7 skipped, 0 failed, 28 still running (all 16 `Test UI` shards, 8 `Test Core` shards, `Build Core`, `Type Check UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Type Check · workspace`). Every gate that has concluded is green; the dev's local red is answered by the `Test UI` shards when they conclude, and the lane's ACCEPT and the queue wait on them as on any PR. This verdict is on the `hits` files and does not turn on those shards; a red shard on this head re-opens ③, not ④.
- **Dev's `check:test-typecheck` heap crash on first run:** re-run green by the dev; CI's `Type Check · debt ledger` is green on the head. Not a diff property.

### ④ Design judgment

Every sentence of the new text, read against the live tree at `origin/main` `aad1603c`:

- **"There is no central feature-flag namespace"** — true. `builtinSettingsManifests` (`packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/index.ts` L29) holds nine manifests: `ai`, `auth`, `branding`, `company`, `knowledge`, `localization`, `mail`, `sms`, `storage` (pinned at nine by `settings-visibility-declaration.pin.test.ts` L77, and `settings-service.test.ts` L51 pins that `feature_flags` is absent). The only other `namespace:` manifest literal in non-test source is `lifecycle` (`packages/objectql/src/lifecycle/lifecycle-settings.ts` L15). No manifest, builtin or plugin-registered, is a feature-flag namespace.
- **"a setting a plugin reads is declared on that plugin's own settings manifest (SettingsManifestSchema, ADR-0007 …)"** — true: `SettingsService.registerManifest` is the one door, and `SettingsManifestSchema` is the shape (`settings-manifest.zod.ts` L680). Naming it from the kernel barrel is fine; it lives under `@objectstack/spec/system`, and a reader grepping the symbol lands on it.
- **"env-overridable via OS_{NAMESPACE}_{KEY}"** — true, and I tried to break it. `envKeyOf` (`settings-service.types.ts` L643–L646) is `'OS_' + \`${namespace}_${key}\`.replace(/[.-]/g, '_').toUpperCase()`. Its one runtime caller, `effectiveEnvOverride` (`settings-service.ts` L1393–L1395), reads `this.env[envName]` for every registered key with no opt-in or allow-list, and `this.env` defaults to `process.env` (L929). So a reader who follows the docblock and sets `OS_MAIL_SMTP_HOST` sets a variable that is read; the only spelling nuance (`.`/`-` → `_`) is one an env-var name forces anyway. The pre-existing hazard is the ADR, not this text: `docs/adr/0007-settings-manifest-and-kv-store.md` L326–L336 still spells the override as bare `MAIL_SMTP_HOST` / `FEATURE_FLAGS_AI_ENABLED` (no `OS_` prefix) — a reader who follows the docblock's ADR citation instead of its own spelling sets a variable that is never read. That is `docs/adr/**`, outside this card's surface and the dev's permitted paths; noted below, not charged to this PR, whose own text gives the live spelling.
- **"the capabilities a deployment advertises to clients are the PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES registry (public-auth-features.ts)"** — true as the registry defines itself: it classifies every boolean flag plugin-auth's `getPublicConfig()` serves on `/api/v1/auth/config` `features`, with a key-set drift guard (`public-feature-registry.test.ts`) and the `requiresFeature` lowering in `ui/action.zod.ts`. Clients read the endpoint; the registry is the spec-side classification of what it carries, which is what a spec docblock should point at.
- **`public-auth-features.ts` docblock: "NOT to be confused with a runtime setting — that is declared on the settings manifest of the plugin that reads it (ADR-0007), not in this registry; there is no central feature-flag namespace (… #3605)"** — consistent with the barrel note and with the tree; the retained `#3605` / `FeatureFlagSchema` history is unchanged and still correct (`kernel/feature.zod.ts` is absent on `main`).
- **`settings-manifest.zod.ts` L14: "(e.g. `mail`, `branding`, `localization`)"** — all three are registered builtins (`mail.manifest.ts` L46, `branding.manifest.ts` L64, `localization.manifest.ts` L34). Replacing rather than dropping the example keeps the docblock's teaching value, and the mdx follows it.
- **Break attempts that failed:** a reader looking for the retired `feature_flags.ai_enabled` / `kanban_swimlanes` / `realtime_cursors` / `inline_comments` has nowhere wrong to look, because #30204's changeset records that none had a reader; a reader wanting a login-page gate is sent to the registry, which names its own consumers; a reader wanting a per-plugin toggle is sent to that plugin's manifest and the `OS_` env form that `envKeyOf` actually produces.

**Findings in `hits`: none must-fix, none should-fix.** The three edits say what the tree does.

Out of scope, noted for a carrier: (1) ADR-0007 L326–L336 env-override table lacks the `OS_` prefix `envKeyOf` produces (`settings-service.types.ts` L645) — a docs-only ADR amendment; (2) the should-fix on the ui pin in ③.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-30282-feature-flags-namespace-text`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L6bhgVugtCCwBs98FeR27P`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：设置中心的副标题在十种语言里都不再提“功能开关”，例如英文改为 “Configure your system and integrations.”。spec 里三段文档注释不再指向已删除的 `feature_flags` 设置命名空间和 `OS_FEATURE_FLAGS_*` 环境变量，改为说明插件的设置写在它自己的设置清单上（环境变量形如 `OS_{NAMESPACE}_{KEY}`），面向客户端的能力开关看 `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES`。

- 风险与回滚：只改文字。没有 key 增删，schema、类型、导出都没变。两个包各出 `patch`。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/console-copy-system-noun-12956.test.ts` 新增的 describe → `packages/spec/src/kernel/index.ts` 和 `public-auth-features.ts` 的注释。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n exec vitest run src/__tests__/console-copy-system-noun-12956.test.ts`，预期全过；把任一语言的副标题改回旧句，对应一条转红。

- 席位意见：接受。契约面达档复核 PASS（comment 6668918657，Head-sha `f1e4de5b`），没有 must-fix；一条 should-fix（pin 没收繁体“功能開關”）不采纳，理由见第 5 项。

## 席位核对

ACCEPT · head `f1e4de5bd241aa4f7569580a535089706ce97443` · 2026-11-05T20:49Z
